clean_repro.probe: POST /v2/vectordb/entities/insert with collection having JSON field 'meta', sending plain string value instead of JSON object
clean_repro.observed: HTTP 200 success, insert accepted. Query returned stored value as plain string 'plain_string' instead of rejecting non-JSON input

valid_assumptions: JSON field 'meta' is defined as dataType: JSON in schema
REST v2 API should validate field types before accepting data

contract_refs: constraint_id: milvus_type_json_001 - JSON scalar data type exists in schema
contract_grounding.note: No explicit contract assertion found stating 'JSON fields must reject non-JSON values', but implicit requirement exists from type system

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: handler_v2.insert() → checkAndSetData() → case DataType_JSON → direct []byte(dataString) conversion WITHOUT validation
source_grounding.note: SOURCE CODE BUG FOUND: Line 760-761 in utils.go shows JSON field accepts ANY string without validation. Should check: json.Valid([]byte(dataString)) or attempt json.Unmarshal() first.

falsification.probe: Query inserted entity with filter 'id in [1]' and outputFields ['meta']
falsification.observed: Query returned {"id":1,"meta":"plain_string"} - confirms the plain string was stored as-is, not rejected or converted to JSON object

excluded: Container timeout issues - tested with small batch (1 entity), immediate response
Collection not loaded - confirmed load success, insert succeeded
Invalid schema - schema created with proper JSON field definition

cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API fails to properly serialize/deserialize complex data types
cognition_match.note: This defect EXACTLY matches bug_shape 'rest-v2-data-type-handling' which has 26 instances in corpus. Issue #52212 specifically mentions 'REST insert stores invalid JSON for a JSON field holding a string'. This is the SAME bug pattern.

contract.explicit_requirement: No explicit contract assertion found requiring JSON fields to reject non-JSON values
contract.note: Contract doesn't explicitly state this constraint, but type system implies it

physical.objective_constraint: JSON fields should only accept valid JSON objects/arrays/primitives (not arbitrary strings)
physical.note: Physical constraint: JSON field MUST accept only valid JSON. API accepts plain string 'plain_string' which is NOT valid JSON.

behavioral.note: No graceful handling, no by-design comments in source. Raw acceptance of any string is clearly a bug.

verdicts.rationale: REST v2 entities/insert endpoint accepts plain string values for JSON fields without validation. Source code (utils.go:760-761) shows direct conversion to []byte without json.Valid() check. Query confirms plain string 'plain_string' was stored as-is, not rejected. This matches known bug_shape 'rest-v2-data-type-handling' (26 instances) and specifically issue #52212. Type constraint violation confirmed.
